::: {#exr-not-and}
#### Not both

A continuous integration server runs two test suites.
Let $P$ be "the unit tests pass"
and $Q$ be "the integration tests pass".

Is "it is not the case that both suites pass", $\neg (P \land Q)$,
logically equivalent (@def-logical-equivalence) to
"neither suite passes", $\neg P \land \neg Q$?

:::
